about: Every speed hypothesis WeedJS has tested or plans to test, plus developer-experience todos (kind `dx`): one short entry each, with a link to its evidence (the log row, the plan entry, the report). Seeded from HYPOTHESIS_LOG.md, EXECUTION_PLAN.md and WASM_HYPOTHESES.md; kept by hand from then on. The page docs/internal/hypotheses.html is built from this file by scripts/buildHypothesesPage.mjs.

statuses.running: Being measured, or built and not yet measured.
statuses.blocked: Waiting on something outside the hypothesis.
statuses.kept: A speed keep: the primary got at least 3 % cheaper and nothing regressed.
statuses.kept-kernel: The kernel won; the product did not move (kept, product-neutral).
statuses.kept-hygiene: A fix or cleanup that stays because nothing got 3 % worse.
statuses.mixed: A split result: read the details.
statuses.screened: A sitting too thin to settle it.
statuses.dropped: Measured under the protocol and not 3 % cheaper (or worse): reverted.
statuses.rejected: Lost in the kernel, or its premise did not hold.
statuses.fail: The sitting did not count (floor, load, regime).
statuses.answered: A question or check that was answered (not a speed claim).
statuses.note: A campaign note: measurements without a verdict of their own.

hypotheses.title: Pixi's lighting draw allocates 36 MB/s
hypotheses.result: Every light's disc and fan in one mesh, the light's terms as vertex attributes; pixel-identical on WebGL and WebGPU. visPolyStressScene renderer 5.472 → 1.361 ms, −75.2 %, worse 0/4; Pixi allocation 36.5 → 8.7 MB/s.

hypotheses.title: Pixi paces its frames to the GPU
hypotheses.result: A WebGL2 fence per frame, read two frames later; a busy GPU gets no new frame. bunnyMarkScene presented frames 54.8 → 59.9 fps, +9.1 %, 4/4 higher (GPU ~98 % on both sides).

hypotheses.title: Pace Pixi's WebGPU path
hypotheses.result: onSubmittedWorkDone completions counted against submissions. bunnyMarkScene?backend=webgpu presented frames 43.4 → 60.0 fps, +38.4 %, 4/4. Renderer mean step +29 % is the frame mix: CPU trace 3.2 → 2.9 ms of Pixi per presented frame.

hypotheses.result: bunnyMarkScene pre-render 21.1 → 6.1 ms per new queue (E-98a–f: no sort line without Y-sort −36.4 %, no emit loop on a sprites-only persist frame −3.7 %, unmasked sprites straight to the collector −14.2 %, poses straight into the queue −14.1 %, the collect writes its rows −15.8 %, bodiless poses inline −18.4 %). E-98g: a frame the other buffer moved is repaired, not a full emit: animatedSpriteStressScene pre-render 8.887 → 7.098 ms, −19.3 %.

hypotheses.title: The split upload for sprites without pose interpolation
hypotheses.result: E-82 split only the pose-interpolated path; the plain path still uploads the 15-float record every frame. pre-render's staticGen is already published.
hypotheses.next: Pays only on frames that keep their rows (a still camera); an animation frame change bumps staticGen, so animated scenes would re-upload statics as often as now unless the texture moves to the pose stream. Measure on animatedSpriteStressScene?sprites=250000 if taken up.

hypotheses.title: Sprite animations froze on persist frames
hypotheses.result: Animations advanced only in the full emit, which a persist frame skips: a scene whose rows held still froze every animation. The persist loop runs the same clock. bunnyMarkScene pre-render +0.9 %.

hypotheses.title: The visibility polygon copy builds two subarray views per light per frame
hypotheses.result: A copy loop instead of set(subarray(...)) per light: no views per frame; visPolyStressScene pre-render −0.3 % (hygiene).

hypotheses.result: buildStampGrid copied caster x, y in bin order for the light walk. shadowStampMicrobench 666 → 658 ops/s (−1.2 %, a tie): the rows fit in cache, the profile's samples were load stalls.

hypotheses.result: Every light's fills and transmit wedges in one mesh, drawn in the light pass; pixel-identical. visPolyStressScene?selfLit=65536 renderer 3.395 → 1.197 ms, −64.9 %, 0/4 worse; Pixi allocation 8.7 → 1.8 MB/s.

hypotheses.result: Pixi's entity rows in the render-queue memory, packed by the W9 kernel: Predator renderer −9.1 % (0/8) but logic +5.9 % (7/8), a worker it cannot reach; layout-only control NEUTRAL, A/A logic −0.9 %. A faster Pixi changes the workers' overlap.

hypotheses.result: The emit skips zero writes into repeat and tile columns no repeating sprite has written. adobeAnimateScene (min zoom) pre-render 26.066 → 23.613 ms, −10.2 %, worse 0/4.

hypotheses.title: The painter sorts runs of equal keys as one
hypotheses.result: radixPainterOrder sorts runs of consecutive equal-key slots (Adobe pieces) by their first slot and expands them; identical order. Kernel pieces +287 %; adobeAnimateScene (min zoom) pre-render 23.452 → 21.157 ms, −9.8 %, worse 0/4.

hypotheses.result: The wedge call only for block < 1, its doubles through a module Float64Array; the helpers it called read them there. Pixi allocation 6.8 → 0.32 MB/s (block 1), 8.4 → 0.33 MB/s (block 0.5); pixel-identical. No pair: Pixi under the 3 ms floor at every load.
